g.title:
11. Enterprise Data Lakehouse & Databricks Data Engineering [Data & Analytics Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Unified lakehouse platform powered by Databricks on Cloud with Delta Lake storage (Cloud OBS/S3). Features Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), Unity Catalog governance, Delta Live Tables (DLT), Photon SQL engine, and MLflow.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Centralizes bank-wide data intelligence. Ingests real-time transactional redo logs from on-prem core banking and cloud databases, consolidates customer 360 golden records, automates CBN/NDIC regulatory returns, and powers real-time AML fraud detection.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Oracle 19c RAC via GoldenGate/Kafka CDC (Port 9092 over Direct Connect), Cloud RDS PostgreSQL via Logical CDC (Port 9092), Batch EOD GL Dumps & NIBSS Journals via SFTP (Port 22) • OUTBOUND: Power BI & Executive Dashboards via Photon JDBC/ODBC (Port 443), Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN Extranet e-FASS/S4), Finacle Core Fraud Alerts via REST API • FAILOVER: Serverless auto-scaling compute clusters across availability zones; Delta Lake ACID transactions with time-travel and multi-AZ object storage. • SECURITY: Unity Catalog fine-grained row-level filtering and dynamic column-level PII masking for BVN/NIN compliance with Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA 2023). (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

Bronze Layer (Raw Ingestion / Landing Zone) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Append-only raw data landing zone in Delta Lake storing pristine copies of incoming data with original schemas and timestamps.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Ingests real-time CDC redo logs from on-premise Oracle 19c RAC (via GoldenGate/Kafka) and Cloud RDS PostgreSQL, alongside batch EOD general ledger flat files.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Oracle 19c RAC CDC via Kafka Connect (TLS Port 9092 over Direct Connect), Cloud RDS CDC via Kafka (Port 9092), Batch EOD files via SFTP (Port 22) • OUTBOUND: Silver Layer via Delta Live Tables (DLT) streaming pipelines • FAILOVER: Cloud Object Storage (OBS/S3) durability (99.999999999%); Delta Lake ACID transaction log. • SECURITY: Server-side KMS encryption, append-only bucket policies, and immutable audit timestamps. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Streaming Change Data Capture (CDC) from On-Prem Oracle 19c RAC (GoldenGate redo logs)
• Cloud Database CDC from Huawei Cloud RDS PostgreSQL & GaussDB via Kafka Connect
• Raw clickstream, mobile telemetry, and EOD batch dumps stored with zero transformation

g.title:
Silver Layer (Cleaned, Conformed Customer 360) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Cleaned, schema-validated, and conformed single source of truth across all banking entities.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Constructs the enterprise Customer 360 golden record by joining Finacle CIF, NIMC NIN, BVN, and Card IDs with automated deduplication and data cleansing.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Bronze Layer via Delta Live Tables (DLT) Declarative Quality Rules • OUTBOUND: Gold Layer Aggregated Marts via Apache Spark DAGs • FAILOVER: Delta Lake time-travel and schema evolution; automated reprocessing from Bronze. • SECURITY: Unity Catalog dynamic column-level PII masking for BVN, NIN, and Card PAN; role-based access control (RBAC). (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Deduplicated, schema-validated, and conformed single source of truth
• Customer 360 Master Data Management (linking Finacle CIF, NIMC NIN, BVN, and card IDs)
• Validated transaction history, general ledger postings, and normalized currency rates

g.title:
Gold Layer (Aggregated Business & Regulatory Marts) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Highly optimized dimensional data marts, pre-calculated aggregates, and feature stores modeled for business intelligence and regulatory compliance.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Directly feeds Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN e-FASS/S4) returns, NDIC risk reports, executive profitability dashboards, and MLflow fraud scoring engines.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Silver Layer via Scheduled Databricks Workflows and Spark Jobs • OUTBOUND: Databricks SQL & Photon Query Engine for Power BI (Port 443), CBN Extranet Reporting Gateway, MLflow Model Serving • FAILOVER: Pre-computed parquet delta tables with partition pruning and Z-order indexing for instant failover recovery. • SECURITY: Unity Catalog row-level security ensuring branch managers and department heads only view authorized business entities. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Executive KPI & Profitability Dashboards, Daily Liquidity Reporting, Product Analytics
• Automated Regulatory Returns: Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN e-FASS / S4) & NDIC reporting
• High-performance Feature Stores for ML models: Credit scoring, churn, fraud propensity

g.title:
Unity Catalog (Unified Governance & Security) [Section 11: Databricks Lakehouse] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Centralized governance engine managing metadata, access permissions, data lineage, and audit trails across all Lakehouse tables, models, and files.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enforces bank-wide compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA 2023) and CBN cyber regulations by automating PII masking and tracking complete data lineage from source to report.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Databricks Workspace Users, Service Principals, and Power BI Connectors • OUTBOUND: Enforces access control policies across Bronze, Silver, Gold Delta Lake tables • FAILOVER: Provider-managed cloud multi-region catalog metadata replication. • SECURITY: Centralized audit log ingestion into CyberSOC Africa SIEM, row/column masking, and NDPA compliance audits. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Centralized governance across all data, AI models, dashboards, and files:
• Fine-Grained Access Control: Row-level filtering and column-level masking for PII (BVN, NIN, Card PAN)
• End-to-End Data Lineage: Automated tracking from source tables (Oracle/PostgreSQL) to Gold dashboards
• Regulatory Compliance: Centralized audit logs for Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and CBN audits
• Storage Layer: Cloud Object Storage (OBS / S3) with Server-Side KMS Encryption & IAM Access
